_comment: Declarative tuning for the matcher (src/matcher.js). This is the extension point: to fix a naming discrepancy between the tier sheet, PCPartPicker and Tweakers, add data here instead of editing matching code. 'aliases' rewrite incoming product names before tokenizing; 'generic' tokens score low (common marketing words); 'noise' tokens are dropped; 'thresholds' decide badge confidence bands.

strip.note: ATX version tags differ across sources and never identify a model
'80+' rating prefix (keeps the trailing Gold/Bronze word)

aliases.note: ASUS TUF '850G' suffix denotes Gold efficiency
marketing word, never part of a tier-sheet model name
Fractal 'Ion 3' is the sheet's 'ION V3' generation
ASRock SL-P is Steel Legend Platinum
